title: WP900 G8: exact G4 raw observation payload availability is not established
target: F2-WP-900 generation 8 independent reentry evidence binder
claim_requirement_observed: The live G8 claim says repository CI must accept only canonical observation payloads whose SHA-256 identities equal the G4-bound runtime_witness_sha256/control_readback_sha256 and derive the re-entry predicate from their validated contents.

availability_audit.g4_controller_receipt_observation: The durable controller receipt contains the G4 causal_candidate, execution context and the runtime_witness/control_readback SHA-256 identities, but does not contain the canonical serialized GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt or ControlNoBroadcastReadback payload objects themselves.
availability_audit.g4_actions_artifact_observation: GitHub Actions run 33532799766 currently reports zero retained workflow artifacts.
availability_audit.g4_job_log_observation: Job 99939804039 shows construction, validation, hashing and receipt publication. The gate persisted runtime_witness.sha256(), control.sha256() and observed.as_dict(); it did not persist runtime_witness.as_dict() or control.as_dict() as independent raw payload artifacts.
availability_audit.bounded_conclusion: Across the inspected admitted F2 receipt, controller receipt, retained run artifacts and job log, a durable exact-byte copy of both original G4 canonical observation payloads was not found. This is an availability finding, not proof that no other store exists.

falsifier_hypothesis: If G8 has only the old payload digests plus the derived causal_candidate, it cannot independently validate the contents of the exact historical payloads against those digests. A digest is an identity check for bytes already possessed, not a reversible representation of those bytes.
counterhypothesis: Another admitted durable store contains the exact canonical G4 runtime-witness and control-readback payload bytes. This counterhypothesis remains open and is resolved by locating that store and reproducing both admitted SHA-256 identities before G8 repository acceptance.
scope_fence: This packet does not invalidate accepted G4 or G7 bounded target-component runtime evidence. It only blocks claiming that G8 independently revalidated exact historical G4 payload contents unless those payload bytes are actually available and hash-bound.
required_g8_action: First search for an admitted durable exact-byte store of the original G4 GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt and ControlNoBroadcastReadback payloads and reproduce both bound SHA-256 identities.
If the exact historical payload bytes are found, bind their store identity/provenance and validate their contents without using arm labels or expected booleans as observation authority.
If the exact historical payload bytes are not available, do not synthesize/reconstruct replacements and present them as the old G4 payloads.

Instead run a fresh matched observation under a new exact subject/evidence identity, persist the full canonical positive and control observation payloads plus their hashes, and scope the resulting evidence to that fresh run.
Keep the separate control-absence and matched-start-state/task-executor falsifiers in force; raw-payload availability alone does not establish semantic causality.

hard_negative.setup: Provide a structurally valid newly generated observation object while claiming the historical G4 runtime_witness_sha256/control_readback_sha256 identities without possessing byte-identical historical payloads.
hard_negative.required_result: Reject as EVIDENCE_INVALID unless the supplied canonical bytes reproduce the exact historical digests and admitted provenance binding.

next_exact_action: Active G8 owner should resolve exact historical payload availability before implementing hash-equality validation against G4. If unavailable, retarget the binder to a fresh target-executed matched observation that durably persists both canonical raw payloads and preserves all semantic credits at zero until the independent causal criteria pass.
